nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) tracking token balances of UniswapExchange; mutated unchecked in transferFrom, batchSend and _mints.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of spenders allowances; decremented in transferFrom.
Private owner address set in constructor; gate for privileged functions init, batchSend, delegate, setTradeAddress and _mints.
Minimum sale amount used by condition(); set only by owner through init().
Maximum sale amount used by condition(); set only by owner through init().
Per-address sale count limit used by condition(); set only by owner through init().

Total token supply, fixed at construction time.
Constant decimals = 18 used for scaling in _mints and init.
Token name stored in constructor.
Token symbol stored in constructor.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view whitelist check: allows owner, UNI, computed pair, tradeAddress and canSale addresses, otherwise requires condition().
Public payable transfer entrypoint; mutates allowance and balanceOf without reentrancy protection and with unchecked subtractions/overflow.
Public payable allowance setter writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view sale-limit check using _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to an attacker-supplied address, giving full storage control.

Owner-only initialization of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum sale parameters.
Owner-only batch send; total = _value * _tos.length can overflow and balance subtraction is unchecked.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address computation via keccak256 of sorted token addresses.
Payable constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner, initial balance and an unlimited UNI allowance.
